```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
read_csv("data/units.csv") -> units
```

```{r}
units %>% 
  count(height_ft)

units %>% 
  filter(height_ft == 10) %>% View()
```

```{r}
units %>% 
  group_by(source) %>% 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price),
    mean_regular_price = mean(regular_price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_regular_price = median(regular_price, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


summary_fns <- list(
  mean = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  median = \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  # sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  # IQR = \(x) IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  # min = \(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  # max = \(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
)

units %>% 
  group_by(category, source) %>% 
  summarize(
  across(c(price, regular_price, area_sqft), summary_fns)
  )
```
